title: Listening Drill — City mural planning — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: City mural planning — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on city mural planning last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with competing drawings. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: damaged surface.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of image contrast so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow wall photos instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the project artist before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Wednesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
